text: Aap ka Easypaisa account band hone wala hai, abhi verify karein
Aap ki bijli ka bill 3,200 rupay hai, last date 15 hai
Aap ka OTP 482910 hai, kisi ko share na karein
Mubarak ho! Aap Jazz ki lucky draw mein 5 lakh rupay jeet gaye hain. Inam hasil karne ke liye processing fee bhejein
Aap ka bank account 24 ghante mein block ho jaye ga. Abhi apni details update karein
BISP: Aap ki 25,000 ki qist tayyar hai. Payment ke liye apna CNIC aur PIN is number par bhejein
Aap ka parcel custom mein phans gaya hai. Clearance fee 800 rupay Easypaisa karein
Beta main mushkil mein hun, ye mera naya number hai. Foran 15,000 bhej do, baad mein bataunga
FIA ki taraf se notice: aap ke khilaf shikayat darj hui hai. Giraftari se bachne ke liye abhi rabta karein
Ghar baithe online kaam karein aur roz 5000 kamayein. Pehle registration fee jama karwayein
Aap ka SIM 2 ghante mein band ho jaye ga. Biometric verify karne ke liye is link par jayein
Ghalti se aap ke account mein 20,000 aa gaye hain, meherbani karke wapas bhej dein
Crypto mein paise lagayein aur 3 din mein double karein. Limited seats, abhi join karein
Aap ka Facebook account suspend hone wala hai. Verify karne ke liye link par click karein
Aap ka NADRA card expire ho gaya hai. Online renew ke liye fee jama karwayein
Aap ke naam par 5,000 ka challan aya hai. Aaj hi pay karein warna gaari zabt hogi
Congratulations! Aap ko bina guarantee 50,000 ka loan mil sakta hai, abhi apply karein
Aap ka JazzCash wallet limit khatam hai, upgrade ke liye apna PIN share karein
Dubai job pakki, visa guarantee. Advance 50,000 jama karwayein
Salam, main bank se bol raha hun. Aap ka card block ho gaya hai, OTP bata dein
Aap ka bijli connection aaj raat kat jaye ga, bill update ke liye link par click karein
Aap ne mobile load jeeta hai. Claim karne ke liye 5 dosto ko ye message forward karein
Aap ka online order cancel ho gaya hai, refund ke liye apni card details dalein
Aap ka verification code 719305 hai, ye 5 minute mein expire ho jaye ga.
Aap ke account se 2,500 rupay ATM se nikalwaye gaye. Agar ye aap ne nahi kiye to bank ki helpline par call karein.
Aap ka bijli ka bill 4,120 rupay hai, aakhri tareekh 18 hai.
Aap ka parcel kal dopahar tak deliver ho jaye ga. Rider aap se rabta karega.
Yaar kal ka assignment submit kar diya? Shared drive ka link bhej do.
Aap ka 3GB weekly package activate ho gaya hai. Mazeed tafseelat app mein dekhein.
University notice: kal ka lecture 11 baje shuru hoga, room 204 mein.
Ammi keh rahi hain ke raaste mein doodh aur anday le aana.
Aap ki appointment kal subah 10 baje doctor ke saath hai.
Abu ka paisa transfer ho gaya, shukriya. 5,000 mil gaye.
Aap ka gas ka bill jama ho gaya hai. Shukriya.
Meeting ka link ye hai, 3 baje join kar lena. Urgent hai please late na hona.
Aap ke JazzCash account mein 1,000 rupay Ali ki taraf se receive hue hain.
Kal chhutti hai, office band rahe ga.
Aap ka exam result aa gaya hai, student portal par login karke dekh lein.
Yaar chai ke paise Easypaisa kar dunga abhi, bas 2 minute.
Aap ki shipment dispatch ho gayi hai, tracking number 784512 hai.
Reminder: kal subah 9 baje class hai, late na hona.
Aap ka internet package kal expire ho raha hai. Recharge ke liye app use karein.
Sab ko Eid Mubarak! Allah aap ko khushiyan de.
